answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases therefore burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the relic deposit is held in the reef escrow, the umber audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
